topFinding: The week of April 11–18, 2026 is a structural inflection point in EP10's legislative trajectory.
keyTakeaways: 🔴 **Record Q1:** **104 adopted texts**, 567 roll-call votes, 6,147 parliamentary questions — **exceeds historical norms** for any EP first quarter.
🟠 **March 26 mega-session:** 9 adopted texts in one sitting (TA-10-2026-0090 → -0098) — Banking Union complete, Anti-Corruption Directive, trade countermeasures, social policy.
🟢 **Pre-Easter session April 7–10:** 6 additional texts (TA-10-2026-0099 → -0104) — content gated by recess API maintenance.
🔵 **Coalition test:** S&D **explicitly linked Housing Initiative (TA-10-2026-0091) to continued support** for EPP agenda.

🟣 **Four parallel recess processes:** (1) Commission housing response, (2) MS finance ministry BRRD3 transposition analysis, (3) **USTR Section 301 watch window April 22–26**, (4) EP political-group internal consultations on April 28–30 agenda.
🩷 **Banking Union completion** (14-year project closure) is the most politically valuable legacy item delivered during a macro window where it matters most.
keyDates: [ ] Commission housing response published without Q4 2026 legislative commitment
keyActors: **Germany stays central across both arcs** — but for different reasons. In Q1,
**Civil-society actors are Q2 ascendant** — housing coalition and anti-corruption
